text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, hematuria, and >100,000 CFU/mL Proteus mirabilis, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI, consider antibiotic therapy, and further evaluation if hematuria persists after infection resolves.
